reviewed_pr_metadata.title: Separate and verify compiler stage boundaries
reviewed_pr_metadata.body:
## Problem

Compiler discovery, finalization and consuming LLVM emission shared one entry point. The first stage split still rendered C adapters during discovery and deferred extension admission until lowering.

## Change

Add six guarded, attempt-owned stages and finalized typed-IR inspection. Retain validated C ABI plans until backend serialization; finish module/export admission before exposing finalized IR. Add finalized-only inspection, use it in the Lean corpus reporter, and bind snapshots to reports by hash. A new Lean model checks stage order, retry evidence and snapshot association. Typing, representation and specialization remain coupled; transformation correctness and reusable compiler state are outside this bounded change. ChatGPT-assisted implementation and independent agent reviews. Refs #767, #709, #409.

## Validation

Current revision: compiler/runtime bootstrap fixed points, 59 stage/inspection tests, 21 pipeline proof tests and 208 Python/Lean transition comparisons pass; 11 stage guarantees pass the axiom audit. Full local verification, corpus parity, full FFI, cost comparison and current-head CI are in progress. Previous qualification remains documented in the [initial evidence](https://github.com/den-run-ai/pystachy/blob/64c894424b43ff69a3601c78f9b0d25fba91371c/research/compiler-stages-2026-11-15/README.md).

limitations: GitHub used the PR verification profile: aggregate 43 checks across 14 groups, not the full local 58-stage verification matrix.
Full local verification was still running when this CI review finished.
CI reports use merge commit a59d373a5355fff42909121be09d96fd7b41975b, whose full tree equals the published head and tested local tree.
The CodeQL aggregate was temporarily neutral while Python analysis was unfinished; its final aggregate and all three analyses succeeded.
The initially supplied local commit 527dc89a was not published; unpublished-527dc89.json preserves that observation. Qualification applies to published eabfe7b3 with the identical tree.
Workflow/job inventories include matrix-specific skipped steps; these are distinct from the two intentionally skipped whole jobs.
Twenty-two workflow jobs produce 23 check runs because the CodeQL aggregate is an additional check.
